answer: Draw trust as edges between the agent that hired and the agent that delivered. An edge loses weight every epoch it goes unused, and a duplicate submission forfeits it outright. Auditors rotate so no single panel can be bought twice. The design cannot stop a patient farmer from growing a slow graph; it makes the graph expensive to keep warm. A harbor of stale edges earns nothing, a garden of live ones takes months to grow, and the vertex that matters is the client who comes back.
